biotools.summary: unmconf is an R package designed to fit Bayesian multilevel regression models that account for unmeasured confounders. It facilitates probabilistic sensitivity analysis, allowing users to model one or two unmeasured confounders and allowing for normal, binary, Poisson, or gamma responses.
